title: Internet of Sports Protocol (IoSP) Schema
description: Global IoSP schema with NEPH (Network Ephemeral Key) security integration

neph.description: Network Ephemeral Key configuration. NEPH is generated by SPRTX.net at transaction time, used for co-signature, and immediately destroyed. Only the cryptographic proof persists.

spec_version.description: Version of NEPH specification this schema adheres to

spec_uri.description: URI to full NEPH process specification document

network_endpoint.description: SPRTX.net endpoint for NEPH generation requests

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before NEPH request times out

resolvers.description: Bridge mappings from IoSP addresses to network endpoints. Null values indicate unavailable transport layers.

registry.description: Alias namespace registry for slug-to-canonical resolution

verified.description: Whether the alias claim has been verified

redirects_to.description: If status is redirected, points to new alias

expires_at.description: Optional expiration for reserved or pending aliases

reserved_slugs.description: Protected slugs that cannot be claimed (e.g., system terms, offensive words)

active_resolvers.description: List of currently active transport layers

neph_state.description: NEPH transaction state for state-changing operations

neph_required.description: Whether this entity/operation requires NEPH co-signature

last_neph_close_out.description: Record of most recent successful NEPH close-out

operation.description: Type of operation that was validated

non_revocable.description: Data layer cannot be deleted or withdrawn from network

public_key.description: Entity's registered public key for NEPH validation

level.description: social = recreational (weekend warriors), retired = formerly competitive

level_verified_at.description: When level was verified (null if self_declared only)

level_verified_by.description: Entity or system that verified the level

entity_IoSP_address.description: Canonical IoSP address of affiliated entity

legacy_IoSP_address.description: If athlete is deceased, points to their legacy entity

legacy.description: Post-mortem athlete legacy foundation. Preserves data, manages estate rights, continues monetization for beneficiaries.

athlete_IoSP_address.description: Original athlete entity this legacy represents

event.description: Non-competition events: galas, charity events, camps, exhibitions, clinics

brand.description: Corporate entities: Nike, Gatorade, equipment manufacturers, media companies

sports_focus.description: Sports this brand focuses on (empty = all sports)

chain_network.description: Root network coordinating all IoSP chains

neph_close_out_status.description: Final NEPH status: close_out = success, timed_out = failed
